finding.title: The meaning of derived is not defined
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds the daily report as a query over the ledger (`the daily report is derived from it`, S:20), and that is wrong because derived does not say whether the report is a view or a stored copy.

e1.text: the daily report is derived from it
e1.context:
## 4. Ledger
R9. Ledger entries are append-only and carry the charge identifier, the amount in minor units and the UTC timestamp.
R10. The ledger is the source of truth for balances; the daily report is derived from it.

## 5. Reports
R11. The daily report lists every captured charge and every refund of the previous UTC day.
